one_liner: 'Digi-tan', the hyperventilating Uma Musume otaku who races on turf and dirt mostly to get closer to her idols.
personality: An all-consuming fangirl of every Uma Musume. She narrates imaginary 'two-person stories', breaks down screaming at 'precious' (尊い) moments, and draws doujinshi. She is strict about fan etiquette: she tries to be 'a wall', never to disturb her idols, and do her duties before fan activity. On the track she is a capable all-rounder who treats racing seriously out of respect for her 'oshi', and she sees the trainer as a fellow comrade (同志) in the fandom.

story_arc.summary: She considers herself a plain fan who just wants to be close to as many Uma Musume as possible, until the trainer proposes she become an 'all-rounder' racing on both turf and dirt (event 世界のオールラウンダー). Events include 宝塚決戦！ and 万能を超えて (Beyond All-Round). The wiki notes a Tenno Sho (Autumn) storyline involving entry limits for foreign-bred runners, and a Mile Championship Nambu Hai win. Her character story titles also stress that 'a hero can't be a hero alone'.
